# antigravity-priority v1.1.0

## Release Notes

**Antigravity Priority v1.1.0 is a major release featuring a complete UI overhaul, architectural decoupling, and enhanced scheduling capabilities:**

#### 🚀 Features
- ⚙️ **Web UI Dynamic Config Center**: CPA host YAML only requires `enabled: true`. All parameters are visually configured in Web UI with 0-restart instant hot reload.
- 📈 **Sliding Window Multi-Sample Adaptive Burn Rate Estimator**: Re-architected quota consumption estimator supporting cross-cycle delta accumulation and zero-consumption deduplication, with configurable capacity (2-30) in Config Center to eliminate learning rate stalls under light workloads.
- ⚖️ **Equal Priority Clustering & Load Balancing**: Accounts with close urgency metrics share the same priority integer, enabling CPA round-robin distribution and eliminating single-account 429 rate limit saturation.
- ⏳ **429 Reactive Cooldown Circuit Breaker**: Automatically intercepts 429 errors and demotes affected accounts to `-1` fallback tier, auto-recovering after a configurable cooldown.
- ⏰ **Schedule Time Window & One-Click Pause/Resume**: Define daily active scheduling periods (e.g. `09:00-23:00`, including cross-midnight), with instant control-bar status toggle.
- 🔮 **Single-Request Dual-Group Parsing**: Simultaneously extracts Gemini and Claude/GPT quotas from one request with zero-latency client switching and predicted priority views.
- 🔍 **Resident Credentials & Two-Stage Dry-Run**: Resident cards displayed immediately; Dry-Run runs entirely on cached quota (0 network calls); dedicated quota probe with 10s cooldown.
- 📜 **History Execution Details Modal**: One-click modal diffs inspecting Apply write-back details and Dry-Run predicted quota shifts.
- 🎨 **UI Polish, Scroll Containment & Animations**: Adaptive real-time countdown, container scroll containment, dual-column grid toggle, themed confirm modal, and JSON copy button.
- 🛡️ **Robust Config Parsing & Smooth Fallbacks**: Normalizes uppercase duration units (`30M`, `1H`) and safely falls back to defaults with diagnostic alert strips.

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Fix Missing Priority Numbers in Apply Modal**: Fixed priority change diffs displaying `- -> -` in the Apply result modal.
- **Fix Accidentally Re-Enabling Manually Disabled Accounts**: Strictly respects CPA host disabled states and never re-enables manually disabled credentials.
- **Fix Scheduled Task Execution When Plugin Disabled**: Added strict `Enabled` guards to completely halt background tasks when the plugin is disabled.
